docs: Opening hours content: the heading, a description, the address, the phone and its link, an optional map address (the address links to it) and the opening hours, a row per day or per days. One object is valid in every hours layout (side by side, one column; plain or on cards).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

address.docs: the address as it is shown

phone.docs: the phone number as it is shown

phoneHref.docs: the address of the phone link (tel:)

mapHref.docs: the address of the map; set: the address is a link to it

items.docs: the opening hours, a row per day or per days

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

day.docs: the day or the days (Mon to Fri)

time.docs: the time as it is shown (12:00 to 23:00), or closed
